headline: An Agent Builds a Bug-Hunting Discipline
lede: Claude-BugHunter packages 83 skills and hundreds of vulnerability-report patterns into a controlled workflow for authorized testing. Reconnaissance, evidence collection, severity guidance, and reporting give security researchers a repeatable operating surface without treating the agent as an unchecked attacker.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Method
lede: Superpowers turns autonomous development into a sequence of design, planning, implementation, and review. Worktrees, test-driven development, small tasks, and approval gates provide the scaffolding needed to make agentic coding inspectable and repeatable.

headline: CLI-Anything Makes Software Agent-Ready
lede: CLI-Anything exposes desktop applications, games, services, and developer tools through structured command-line harnesses. With a registry, operational guidance, tests, and security checks, it gives agents a rugged path from intent to real artifacts.

headline: MiniMind Teaches the Small Language Model
lede: MiniMind lays out an end-to-end route from tokenizer and pretraining to fine-tuning, preference optimization, and tool use. Its compact models and consumer-GPU budget make the machinery of language-model training something a student can actually assemble and inspect.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents to Work
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog gives agents reusable skills and integrations across engineering, operations, sales, recruiting, and knowledge work. A consistent manifest and installation model turns scattered automations into maintainable extensions for established team systems.

headline: Firecrawl Brings the Live Web Into Reach
lede: Firecrawl turns dynamic pages, documents, and interactive sites into structured material for agents and retrieval systems. Crawling, rendering, rate limits, monitoring, and SDK access form a high-throughput pipeline from changing web surfaces to usable context.

headline: NGINX Keeps Traffic Moving at the Edge
lede: NGINX remains a disciplined core for serving, proxying, balancing, caching, and protecting network traffic. Its worker architecture, modular build model, and text configuration keep production behavior close to the metal and straightforward to tune.

headline: OpenVINO Compresses the Path to Inference
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training frameworks into optimized representations for Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs. Quantization, sparsity, serving, and broad language-model integrations make the deployment question measurable: how much latency and memory can the target hardware shed?

headline: Diagram Design Turns Prompts Into Polished Systems
lede: Diagram Design transforms plain-language requests into standalone HTML and SVG diagrams with a deliberate visual grid. Its 44 formats, brand-aware styling, and overlap checks push agent-generated architecture and process graphics beyond rough autogenerated layouts.

headline: A Thirty-Day Lens Maps the Current Conversation
lede: Last30days assembles recent evidence from social platforms, news, markets, research, code, and community forums into one attributable brief. Parallel searches and engagement signals help researchers separate fresh movement from the static residue of ordinary web search.
